motions.purpose: Provide an explorable cinematic Moon scene with trajectory playback, prediction path, attitude slew, and visible burn windows.
motions.limitations: The imported 1200-sample path and burn windows are a visual prototype, not a mission ephemeris, NRHO solution, navigation product, or high-fidelity lunar propagation.
motions.reducedMotion: Freeze the trajectory at progress 0.18, stop Moon and camera rotation, and keep every control and truth label readable.
motions.exportState: Freeze at progress 0.18, remove stars and controls, and retain the truth label.
motions.accessibility: Native controls have labels, the figure is keyboard focusable, and visible text states the model status and limitations.
